mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the last month suggests a weakening economy, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 10% in the last two months indicates a decline in consumer demand, which is likely to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 10% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in the last two months signals a strengthening supply side, which typically boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 2% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, suggests a stable monetary policy, which is conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the last month, it indicates a strong labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, which is likely to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 was negative for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and decreasing consumer spending (RSAFS) suggests a tightening monetary policy coupled with weakening demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% and RSAFS decrease > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% and RSAFS decreased by more than 5% in the previous month.
